source.title: Space, Time, and Fear: Survival Computations along Defensive Circuits

confidence_rationale: A strong synthesis of the threat-imminence framework, which is almost a direct description of the anti-epistemic-panic pole: as a threat becomes proximal/surprising, the system contracts its decision and state space and switches from model-based (deliberative, information-gathering) to model-free (fast, reactive) computation. That is exactly 'collapse the epistemic term and commit under urgency'. High relevance and source quality; capped by being a review framework and by the species/circuit specifics not mapping one-to-one onto REE.
failure_signatures: Anti-epistemic-panic: at high threat imminence the deliberative/model-based route is abandoned for model-free reaction BEFORE the belief-state is disambiguated -- adaptive when imminence is genuinely high, pathological when it fires on uncertain or distal threat.
The same axis predicts the opposite failure when imminence is mis-estimated as low (over-deliberation), linking to epistemic-freezing.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Defensive decisions occur at different spatiotemporal scales: distal/uncertain threats permit extended information processing via model-based circuits, whereas proximal/surprising threats reduce the decision and state space and recruit fast model-free architectures (e.g. midbrain/PAG) -- a graded switch in computation governed by threat imminence.
mapping.ree_translation: The biology of anti-epistemic-panic in MECH-434: rising threat imminence shifts the agent from epistemic, deliberative inference (sample where safety is) to reactive commitment on a contracted hypothesis space. It grounds the claim that commitment timing is THREAT-modulated -- the urgency term of MECH-434 is driven up by imminence, exactly the pressure 603k's ARM_HARM_ON_MIDLINE creates.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Threat-imminence work is grounded in mammalian survival circuits (amygdala, PAG, hypothalamus) REE does not implement as such; the mapping is functional (imminence -> shorter deliberation -> faster commitment), not anatomical. Whether the model-based/model-free switch is the right primitive for REE's belief-state commitment is itself a design question.
mapping.source_context: Theoretical review synthesising rodent and human threat/defence neuroscience under a threat-imminence / survival-computation framework.

confidence_components.notes: High-quality TICS review. Mapping fidelity strong for the panic pole (imminence-driven deliberation->reaction switch); transfer risk moderate (survival-circuit anatomy not REE's).
